statement.zh: 乔加马米 1967–68 年发掘出土萨马拉相关聚落证据，见 Oates 1969 Iraq 初步报告。
statement.en: At Choga Mami, the 1967–68 excavations yielded Samarran-related settlement evidence, as documented in Oates’s 1969 Iraq preliminary report.
